name: chinese-chess-3d-web
description: Browser-based 3D Xiangqi with local play, client-side AI, and optional WebRTC friend matches.

scripts.prebuild: npm run assets:ai:validate && npm run security:metadata
scripts.prepare:model: npm run optimize:model && npm run inspect:model
scripts.test:online:e2e: NEXT_PUBLIC_XIANGQI_ONLINE_ENABLED=1 PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_SERVER=0 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER_COMMAND='npm run dev -- --port 3100' playwright test tests/e2e/online-match.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts --project desktop-chromium
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:rules && npm run test:game && npm run test:online && npm run test:ai && npm run test:presentation
scripts.test:e2e:release: playwright test tests/e2e/gameplay.spec.ts tests/e2e/two-player-match.spec.ts tests/e2e/computer-match.spec.ts --config playwright.production.config.ts --project desktop-chromium
scripts.test:audio:browsers: AUDIO_BROWSER_MATRIX=1 playwright test tests/e2e/audio.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts --project desktop-chromium --project audio-firefox --project audio-webkit
scripts.test:ai:lifecycle: RUN_AI_LIFECYCLE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/computer-match.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts --project desktop-chromium --grep 'keeps one Worker and stable lifecycle resources'
scripts.test:performance: RUN_RENDER_PERFORMANCE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/performance.spec.ts --config playwright.performance.config.ts --project desktop-chromium
scripts.test:performance:headed: RUN_RENDER_PERFORMANCE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_MEASUREMENT_MODE='Visible Chromium rendered-frame interval; not CPU time or GPU render duration' playwright test tests/e2e/performance.spec.ts --config playwright.performance.config.ts --project desktop-chromium --headed
scripts.test:budget: node scripts/verify-runtime-budgets.mjs && node scripts/verify-audio-assets.mjs && node scripts/verify-ai-engine-assets.mjs
